title: ESP Atlas Firmware
description: A flashable ESP32 firmware project. First-class entity like `brand`: never indexed into the queryable parts table, never a /search or /wizard result. See SPEC-wizard.md.

benefits_from.description: OPTIONAL soft/UX capabilities the firmware benefits from beyond its hard `capabilities` -- a closed vocab of things a board's own structured fields can prove: an onboard `display`, a microSD in `extras` (`storage`), `power.battery_connector`, native `usb`, or a `gps` module in `extras`. Never a hard requirement; run_guide reasons about presence/absence to teach fit, never to gate it.

requires.description: OPTIONAL, grounded requirement-rationale: hard capabilities this firmware needs and WHY, authored verbatim by the maintainer/dataset author. `board_signal` names the structured board field run_guide checks to state met/unmet for a given board (see esp_atlas_core.run_guide's signal matchers), or is `null` when the capability cannot be proven or disproven from any board's structured record (e.g. sub-GHz radio, NFC, IR) -- taught as a need, never asserted met/unmet.

not_required.description: OPTIONAL, grounded rationale for a capability this firmware explicitly does NOT need (e.g. PSRAM) -- authored verbatim, never a gate, only a teaching point run_guide surfaces regardless of what a given board happens to carry.

socs.description: SoC families the project builds for
